_comment: Demo data. Two incidents deliberately share a root cause so the agent has something to actually notice, and payments-worker is deliberately over its error budget.

incidents.title: Checkout API returning 503 for 18% of requests
incidents.customerImpact: Roughly 1 in 5 checkout attempts failed for 2h35m. 4,102 abandoned carts.
incidents.rootCause: Connection pool exhaustion after the payments-worker deploy raised concurrent outbound calls.

incidents.title: Payments worker queue backlog
incidents.customerImpact: Payment confirmations delayed up to 40 minutes. No lost payments.
incidents.rootCause: The 09:00 deploy doubled outbound concurrency without raising the pool ceiling.

incidents.title: Search results stale by up to 30 minutes
incidents.customerImpact: New listings took up to 30 minutes to appear. No errors shown to users.
incidents.rootCause: Indexer lag behind a bulk import.

incidents.title: Payment confirmation emails not sending
incidents.customerImpact: Customers are charged correctly but receive no confirmation email. 900+ affected so far.

incidents.title: Elevated latency on the public API
incidents.customerImpact: p95 latency up from 240ms to 1.1s. Slow but working.
